title: Direct image with finite Tor amplitude
statement:
Let $A=A_{E,n}$ be a finite coefficient stage, let $f:X\to Y$ be separated
of finite type, of finite-type $k$-schemes with
$\dim X\le d$, and let $K$ be a bounded constructible $A$-complex on
$X_{\Et}$ with finite Tor amplitude in $[a,b]$. Then $Rf_*K$ is bounded
constructible on $Y_{\Et}$ with finite Tor amplitude in $[a,b+2d]$. The standing field is $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$, with $\ell\ne p$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]; $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ is finite, $\mathcal O_E$ is its valuation ring, $\varpi_E$ is a chosen uniformizer, and $n\ge1$ with $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Finite type and separatedness have the meanings of [def-weil-finite-type-morphism; def-weil-proper-morphism], and dimension is the topological Krull dimension [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Use ordinary module-sheaf derived categories on the small étale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], bounded constructibility as in [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes], the module derived direct image of [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], and Tor amplitude tested against every degree-zero module sheaf as in [def-kun-tor-amplitude].

proof.text: Use the standing datum of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]: $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ has characteristic $p$ and $\ell\ne p$. The coefficient definition and [lem-weil-l-adic-extension-integers-dvr] give $\mathfrak m_E=(\varpi_E)$ and the extended absolute value. By [lem-weil-valued-dvr-finite-quotients], $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ is finite local with maximal ideal generated by $\bar\varpi_E$; write $\kappa=A/(\bar\varpi_E)$. Every ideal of $A$ is generated by its finite set of elements, so $A$ is Noetherian. Since $|\ell|_E=\ell^{-1}<1$, one has $\ell\in\mathfrak m_E=(\varpi_E)$, hence $\ell^n\in(\varpi_E^n)$ and $\ell^n A=0$. The positive integer $\ell^n$ is invertible in $k$ because $\ell\ne p$.

source.place: Proof, coefficient setup (first paragraph of the finite-coefficient argument)

proof.text: Put $L=K\otimes_A^L\kappa_X$. The definition [def-kun-tor-amplitude], tested against the degree-zero module sheaf $\kappa_X$, gives $\mathcal H^q(L)=0$ for $q\notin[a,b]$. Thus $L$ belongs to $D^+$ as defined in [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Explicitly, choose any representing complex $C$ and set $C'^i=0$ for $i<a$, $C'^a=\operatorname{coker}(d_C^{a-1})$, and $C'^i=C^i$ for $i>a$, with the induced differential. The projection $C\to C'$ induces the identity on cohomology in degrees at least $a$ and an isomorphism between zero cohomology sheaves in lower degrees. It is therefore a quasi-isomorphism, so $C'$ is a bounded-below representative of $L$ for the next step.

The module-sheaf categories on the small étale sites are Grothendieck abelian, the module direct image is additive and left exact, and its right derived functor is the $Rf_*$ of [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Applying [thm-sp-truncation-e2] to the bounded-below representative $C'$ of $L$ from Step 2 gives the truncation spectral sequence
$$E_2^{p,q}=R^pf_*\bigl(\mathcal H^q(L)\bigr)\Longrightarrow\mathcal H^{p+q}(Rf_*L).$$

Apply [lem-sf-etale-direct-image-vanishing] with the algebraically closed $k$, the given $\dim X\le d$, and $A$ annihilated by the invertible integer $\ell^n$. It gives $R^pf_*M=0$ for every $A$-module sheaf $M$ and $p>2d$. This is $\operatorname{UDV}(f,A;2d)$ by [def-sf-uniform-direct-image-vanishing], whose global-field and separatedness hypotheses hold here. The page of Step 3 is therefore supported in $0\le p\le2d$, $a\le q\le b$. For $t<a$ or $t>b+2d$, every term on the diagonal $p+q=t$ is zero. Later page terms are subquotients of earlier ones, hence the stable diagonal is zero. The finite exhaustive separated abutment filtration of [thm-sp-truncation-e2] has these stable terms as successive quotients. Starting at its zero end, induction on its finite length gives $\mathcal H^t(Rf_*L)=0$ outside $[a,b+2d]$.

source.place: Proof, uniform vanishing and rectangle paragraph

proof.text: The bounded constructibility theorem [thm-dg-finite-type-constructibility] applies because $X$ and $Y$ are finite type over $k$, $A$ is finite and its exponent is invertible in $k$, and $K$ is bounded constructible. Hence $F:=Rf_*K$ is bounded constructible on $Y_{\Et}$.

The quotient $\kappa$ has a finite presentation over the Noetherian ring $A$ (the sequence $A\xrightarrow{\varpi_E}A\twoheadrightarrow\kappa\to0$). The UDV bound from Step 4 and the fact that $K$ is bounded above allow [lem-sf-projection-finite-constant] to be applied with $M=\kappa$. It identifies the canonical projection map
$$(Rf_*K)\otimes_A^L\kappa_Y\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf_*(K\otimes_A^L\kappa_X)=Rf_*L.$$
This is the ordinary uncompleted étale tensor and the same module direct image as in the preceding spectral sequence. Both $K$ and $L$ are bounded below. On these objects the unbounded K-injective direct image of [def-kun-projection-formula-map] and the bounded-below direct image of [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] are computed by the same formula $Q(f_*I)$ for a K-injective resolution; thus the projection comparison is for precisely the direct images used above.

Apply [lem-exc-residue-tor-test] to the bounded constructible complex $F$ on $Y$ with residue field $\kappa$ and endpoints $a$ and $b+2d$. Steps 4 and 6 give the required vanishing of $\mathcal H^i(F\otimes_A^L\kappa_Y)$ outside that interval, so the residue criterion yields Tor amplitude in $[a,b+2d]$. Together with Step 5 this proves both clauses of the theorem.

split_report.summary: Audited the current finite-coefficient theorem against the main-20261015 blueprint and the Lean source. No new nodes were needed: the proof uses existing finite-coefficient arithmetic, étale direct-image vanishing, the truncation spectral sequence, finite-type constructibility, the finitely presented constant-coefficient projection formula, and the residue-field Tor test. The two target declarations in slopmaster2 are still sorry_here and are not attachments. The statement remains the exact finite-stage bound [a,b+2d], with standing coefficient/field and site conventions explicit. Second reading replaced the flat-model step by the explicit good lower truncation of the residue tensor: the only fact the unit takes from the flat model, concentration of $K\otimes^L_A\kappa_X$ in $[a,b]$, is the definition of Tor amplitude tested on $\kappa_X$, so the cited unit sk-lem-sf-flat-model (whose node lem-sf-flat-model does have an étale clause) is not needed. Maintainer reading: the item states exactly the same as the reviewed node cor-sf-direct-image-ctf-nonproper (same unit); its seven steps are the steps of thm-sf-direct-image-tor-amplitude with $N=2d$; the two should be merged by the maintainer.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q59-a1ec12ee9 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the whole item: the statement, all 7 steps and the full statement of every cited node, plus the main-20261015 unit, its proof and the cor-sf-direct-image-ctf-nonproper files, and slopmaster2 DirectImage.lean (both declarations are sorry and more general than the node). The statement matches the blueprint hypothesis by hypothesis: finite stage A_{E,n} over k = algebraic closure of F_q, ordinary étale module sheaves, exact shift [a,b+2d]. Nothing is weakened and there is no base-change morphism in this item. Step 1: the DVR and finite-quotient lemmas, with Noetherian and ell^n*A=0 proved in the step. Step 2: Tor amplitude tested on kappa_X plus a good truncation coker(d^{a-1}); elementary. Step 3: Grothendieck abelian, left exact, K-injective Rf_*, and clauses 2 and 6 of thm-sp-truncation-e2. Step 4: lem-sf-etale-direct-image-vanishing for every module sheaf gives UDV(f,A;2d); the rectangle plus the finite filtration of clause 5 give the bound [a,b+2d]. Step 5: thm-dg-finite-type-constructibility. Step 6: lem-sf-projection-finite-constant (A Noetherian, N=2d, K in D^-, kappa finitely presented); the unbounded and D^+ direct images agree on bounded-below objects. Step 7: lem-exc-residue-tor-test with the same kappa. proof_deps equals the union of uses and the dependency closure has no cycle. Small cases: id with K=A[-1] keeps [1,1]; P^1 gives exactly [0,2]; n=2 has kappa of infinite projective dimension, which Step 6 allows; empty, zero and a>b cases are trivial. One repair, in split_report.summary only: the second reader dropped sk-lem-sf-flat-model on the grounds that it is pro-étale only, which is false (lem-sf-flat-model has an étale clause and an étale constructible variant). The real reason is that the one fact the unit takes from it is the definition of Tor amplitude; the summary now says so. I accept all nine declared tool_uses; no SGA source is cited. For the maintainer: the item states exactly the same theorem as the reviewed node cor-sf-direct-image-ctf-nonproper (same unit), and its steps are those of thm-sf-direct-image-tor-amplitude with N=2d, so the two imported nodes should be merged.
